title: add: git sources use cache

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
git sources were not using cache because of 2 independent issues: the .git dir was always being included in the copied content (fixed in #7062 ) which now excludes it by default, and the content digester was using Start("") instead of Start("dir"). Start("") skips tar-header timestamp normalization that Start("dir") does which causes a new digest to happen since `git checkout` writes fresh mtimes on every clone.
#### How to verify it
`bats --show-output-of-passing-tests -f "bud with add instruction caches git source" ./tests/bud.bats`
#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
Fixes #6165
